blockDom: div.section.<name>-container > div.<name>-wrapper > div.<name>.block[data-block-name]; default content in div.default-content-wrapper
buttonMapping: strong = primary (frach-e-button--primary), em = secondary (--secondary), strong+em = accent (--tertiary with arrow); canon .button--* classes kept for block JS
sectionMetadata: server-rendered (aem.js decorateSections reads no section-metadata table); style values arrive as section classes
cellNormalization: wrapTextNodes folds non-block-level first children into one
chrome: header/footer blocks load /nav and /footer fragments (nav/footer metadata override)
fonts: styles/fonts.css via loadFonts() (desktop >= 900px eager, always in loadLazy); metric fallbacks in styles/styles.css
documentLang: de (en for /en paths), set in loadEager
